title: Kestrel and the Sigil Anew
author: Zephyrine Winterbourne
blurb: Zephyrine Ravensworth, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
